scripts.docker:up:watch: trap 'docker compose down --remove-orphans' INT TERM; docker compose up --remove-orphans -V
scripts.docker:rebuild:watch: trap 'docker compose down --remove-orphans' INT TERM; docker compose up --build --remove-orphans -V
scripts.docker:clean: docker compose down --remove-orphans -v && docker image prune -f
scripts.docker:nuke: docker compose down --remove-orphans -v --rmi local && docker system prune --volumes -f
scripts.shell:postgres: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d markersdb
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down && docker volume rm realtime-markers-demo_postgres_data && docker compose up -d postgres && sleep 10 && docker compose exec backend pnpm migration:run
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec backend pnpm migration:run
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec backend pnpm seed
